adjudication.rationale: The diff shows Admin::EmbeddingController#update does not persist any changes (it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` like `#show`), so the PUT endpoint is effectively a no-op. On the client side, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` only wires actions for `addHost` and `deleteHost` (and the component handles per-host save/delete). There is no template trigger for `saveChanges`, making it dead/incomplete scaffolding. This is an implementation/scope issue rather than a clearly broken behavior since host CRUD is handled via `embeddable_hosts` resources.
